nvitk.registration¶

Medical image registration helpers (FSL + optional ANTsPy / FireANTs).

  • nvitk.registration.ants
  • nvitk.registration.cli
  • nvitk.registration.fireants
  • nvitk.registration.fsl

Classes¶

Paths and NiPype runtime from a FLIRT rigid run.

AntsRegistrationResult

Paths produced by an ANTs registration: warped moving image and forward/inverse transforms.

FireAntsResult

Outputs produced by fireantsRegistration.

Functions¶

flirt_apply_rigid(→ pathlib.Path)

Apply an existing FLIRT *.mat transform (-applyxfm).

flirt_register_rigid(→ FlirtRigidResult)

Run FLIRT rigid alignment of moving towards fixed reference image.

ants_apply(→ pathlib.Path)

Apply transforms to map MOVING into FIXED space.

ants_register(→ AntsRegistrationResult)

Register MOVING to FIXED and write outputs under out_dir.

fireants_apply(→ pathlib.Path)

Apply FireANTs transforms if fireantsApplyTransforms is available.

fireants_register(→ FireAntsResult)

Run a default multi-stage FireANTs registration (Rigid→Affine→SyN).

nvitk.registration.flirt_register_rigid(moving: str | pathlib.Path, fixed: str | pathlib.Path, out_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, dof: int = 6, cost: str = 'corratio', warped_name: str = 'moving_warped.nii.gz', matrix_name: str = 'affine.mat', searchr_x: float | None = None) → FlirtRigidResult¶

Run FLIRT rigid alignment of moving towards fixed reference image.

Writes matrix_name under out_dir and optionally a warped moving image. Requires FSL on PATH and FSLDIR set (NiPype delegates to flirt).
